description: Curated scene packs for AI tools: each pack = one real-world scenario, containing multiple skills. Download zip -> unzip -> drag the skill folders into your AI tool's skills directory.
description_zh: 精选场景包合集：每个场景包 = 一个真实场景，内含多个 skill。下载 zip -> 解压 -> 把 skill 文件夹拖进 AI 工具的 skills 目录即可使用。

source_notes.alirezarezvani/claude-skills (MIT): 35 skills curated from the open-source claude-skills project (MIT license).
source_notes.weed33834 (self-authored): 4 skills authored by the repo owner (agent-builder-skill, chinese-parents-skill, cnblogs-skill, zhihu-content-manager).

packs.name: AI Agent Development
packs.description: Build production-grade AI agents, design multi-agent workflows, MCP servers, feature flags, and self-evaluation.
packs.description_zh: 构建生产级 AI Agent、设计多 Agent 工作流、MCP 服务、功能开关与自评。

packs.name: API Development & Testing
packs.description: Review REST API designs and generate integration/contract test suites.
packs.description_zh: 审查 REST API 设计并生成集成/契约测试套件。

packs.name: System Architecture
packs.description: Design system architecture, plan zero-downtime migrations, and navigate monorepos.
packs.description_zh: 设计系统架构、规划零停机迁移、驾驭 monorepo。

packs.name: Blog Publishing
packs.description: Publish and manage posts on cnblogs.com: research, writing, images, API publishing.
packs.description_zh: 博客园发文与管理：选题、写作、配图、API 发布。

packs.name: CI/CD Pipeline
packs.description: Generate pragmatic CI/CD pipelines, release gates, and spec-driven development workflows.
packs.description_zh: 生成务实的 CI/CD 流水线、发布门禁与规范驱动开发流程。

packs.name: Code Review
packs.description: Review pull requests, analyze code quality, audit dependencies and tech debt across languages.
packs.description_zh: 审查 PR、分析代码质量、审计依赖与技术债，覆盖多语言。

packs.name: Containers & Orchestration
packs.description: Dockerfile optimization, docker-compose, Helm charts, and Kubernetes operators.
packs.description_zh: Dockerfile 优化、docker-compose、Helm Chart 与 Kubernetes Operator。

packs.name: Database Design & Management
packs.description: Design schemas, ERD diagrams, migrations, and optimize SQL queries.
packs.description_zh: 设计表结构、ERD 图、迁移方案，并优化 SQL 查询。

packs.name: Family Communication
packs.description: Simulate, diagnose, and cope with Chinese-parent behavior via a 10-dimension profile.
packs.description_zh: 用 10 维画像模拟、诊断与应对中国式家长。

packs.name: GitHub Collaboration
packs.description: Parallel worktrees, conventional-commit changelogs, and PR review on GitHub.
packs.description_zh: 并行 worktree、Conventional Commits 变更日志与 GitHub PR 审查。

packs.name: Incident Response & SRE
packs.description: Command incidents, generate runbooks, and define SLOs/error budgets.
packs.description_zh: 事故指挥、生成 runbook、定义 SLO 与错误预算。

packs.name: Infrastructure as Code
packs.description: Terraform patterns, observability design, and Kubernetes operators.
packs.description_zh: Terraform 模式、可观测性设计与 Kubernetes Operator。

packs.name: Performance Profiling
packs.description: Profile CPU/memory/I/O bottlenecks in Node.js, Python, and Go.
packs.description_zh: 剖析 Node.js、Python、Go 的 CPU/内存/IO 瓶颈。

packs.name: Security & Secrets
packs.description: Set up secret vaults and manage environment-variable hygiene.
packs.description_zh: 搭建密钥库并管理环境变量卫生。

packs.name: Test-Driven Development
packs.description: Write unit tests, fixtures, mocks, and guide red-green-refactor cycles.
packs.description_zh: 编写单元测试、fixture、mock，并引导红绿重构循环。

packs.name: Zhihu Publishing
packs.description: Publish/edit/delete Zhihu articles, manage drafts, topics, covers, and fix garbled text.
packs.description_zh: 知乎文章发布/编辑/删除、草稿、话题、封面与乱码修复。
